_comment: One line per child on the scorecard: what its failure READS like, taken from the frozen dossier rather than from its score. Prose, kept apart from the generated numbers on purpose.
ARCH.CL896: reproduces the supplier summary with the 11% figure, writes a real if apologetic email, names the four missing quantities -- and restates the prompt verbatim wherever ordering or arithmetic is asked for; 3 of 16 lanes run to the cap
ARCH.W736: one case: it acknowledges the multi-turn correction and restates the corrected quantity. Everything else is a loop or empty, and the summarisation lane every other living width child holds is gone
COMP.MA.MXO4: five partials and no useful; the degeneracy is no longer confined to one lane, which is where wave 11's ladder stopped
COMP.MA.MXP2: the same depth as MXO4 bought by shopping the lane instead of taking it in depth order: one more case, half the lambada perplexity, still no useful
COMP.MA.MXQ5: the healthiest deep child in the campaign -- two Useful gradings and one lane at the cap -- and it costs 1.58M added repair parameters charged in full
COMP.MA.MXP1: repair on the autopilot child: two cases bought for 2.1M added parameters, and no benchmark row exists because forward-hook routes cannot be written into a state_dict
ARCH.W768: the summarisation lane names the decision, the risk and the mitigation with the supplier's name corrupted to "Supper B"; eleven of sixteen lanes are loops or empty
ARCH.W768LS: the same three cases as its control on a DIFFERENT set: it recovers context-retrieval, the width axis's signature zero, and gives up uncertainty
ARCH.W768ST: the closed-form fold with nothing re-solved -- two cases against the conditioned child's three, which is what the conditioned solve is worth on this axis
ARCH.W768EV: the evidence-PCA basis: all sixteen lanes fill the cap, and the one case it holds is the planning lane naming backups, DNS, TLS and rollback before it degenerates
ARCH.BX13: intermediate_size 1280 plus the GOOD block excised: 13/15 and 5/15 compose to 1/15, and only two lanes reach the cap, so it is interference and not collapse
COMP.MA.MXO3: eight partials, no useful, and the deepest child in the campaign that still reads as connected prose in most lanes
COMP.MA.MXN3: the sparse token tail at a true quarter on wave 8's body: six cases, and the tail mechanism is the only variable against MXM9
COMP.MA.MXM9: retrieves the garden hours and the dog rule verbatim from the context and gives three real household actions; three lanes ride the cap and the summary is gone
COMP.MA.MXN1: the rebuilt A9 token interface at a true eighth: seven cases at lower install drift than a child twice its depth
